en.hubeali: And from him, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws was asked about the Words of Allahazwj the Exalted [20:5] The Beneficent is Even upon the Throne.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Even with regards to everything. So there isn’t anything closer to Him<sup>azwj</sup> than a (another) thing. The remote is not far from Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and the close-by is not closer to Him<sup>azwj</sup>. He<sup>azwj</sup> is Even with regards to everything’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) the following about the words of Allah. “The Beneficent God is dominant over the Throne (of the realm).” [20:5]
“No single thing is closer to Him than any other thing. The far is not far for Him and the close is not closer to Him. All are the same to Him.”
